value.rationale: A natural gcd-weighted circulant has a full squarefree-order integer cokernel classification, a computationally compact prime-local prescription, exact primewise modular ranks and a sharp generator-number dichotomy controlled by congruence classes of prime factors. These integral invariants are not determined by classical spectra alone and are useful for arithmetic integral-lattice calculations without a larger theorem.
